thread:
Jordan (CSM): Morning team — Brineyard week0 health triage. Goal: green on networking, IAM, KMS access, and audit forwarding before cutover Friday. Any fresh blockers?

Priya (CS Ops): Quick summary from onboarding survey: peering up, but customer reports intermittent DNS resolution to our API host when connection is through their transit gateway.

Alex (NetEng): That usually points to asymmetric routing or missing return-route for the transit attachment. I need their route tables and TGW attachment IDs. I asked their infra for those 20m ago.

Maya (Support): Customer pasted packet capture — SYN to api.redwood-inference.com, SYN-ACK reaches our edge, but ACK never completes. Looks like return packets dropped at their egress ACL.

Sam (Security): On IAM/Cross-account role: their AssumeRole works now but they scoped Principal to an org unit instead of the exact role ARN. That's ok for now but less secure. Recommend we require exact role ARN in prod.

Jordan (CSM): Noted. Add as a hardening action post-cutover. For this week we need functionality.

Priya (CS Ops): KMS: They supplied CMKs with key origin EXTERNAL and we saw kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext failing. They are using an HSM-backed workflow and their key policy blocks cross-account GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext.

Sam (Security): We can support both GenerateDataKey and GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext. For their CMK we need the key policy to explicitly allow our service role to use both actions. I'll provide a minimal key policy snippet.

Alex (NetEng): Re: DNS — if TGW breaks, temporary workaround is to add explicit host entries on their NAT instances or the VMs making requests. Not ideal but feasible for short window.

Maya (Support): Their compliance lead asked about audit logs retention and SIEM integration. They need 2 years of immutable logs. Our default workspace retention is 90d and S3 bucket lifecycle currently 180d.

Jordan (CSM): Two-year retention is a significant storage delta; flagging as renewal-risk if not agreed. Sam, can security approve extended retention and immutability options?

Sam (Security): We can enable WORM on their dedicated bucket and extend retention. I'll open infra ticket to evaluate cost and confirm immutability meets their compliance controls.

OpsBot: Automated check: service-account role redwood-inference: AssumeRole policy mismatch detected — last test failed (error: ExternalId missing). See TICKET-CS-9021.

Priya (CS Ops): I uploaded an onboarding runbook section: /runbooks/brineyard/week0/ with: 1) network checklist (TGW, RTs, ACLs), 2) IAM role example, 3) KMS snippet, 4) SIEM/HEC fallback.

Jordan (CSM): Great. Action owners: Alex — chase their network team for TGW RTs and propose short-term host entry workaround (owner: Alex). Priya — DM the IAM trust + KMS snippets and confirm they apply them (owner: Priya). Sam — open retention/immutability infra ticket and estimate cost (owner: Sam). Maya — coordinate a 30m window for cert rotation and Splunk HEC validation with customer (owner: Maya).

Maya (Support): Scheduled cert rotation for Thursday 2pm UTC. I'll set up the validation call and post dial-in here.

Alex (NetEng): Update: customer responded with TGW attachment IDs and route tables. Found missing 0.0.0.0/0 route on the spoke RT pointing to TGW. Sending note to their infra.

Priya (CS Ops): They applied IAM trust patch — we re-tested AssumeRole and it's now successful. KMS still failing on GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext; they said their KMS admin is reviewing the change.

Sam (Security): Infra ticket opened for retention (INFRA-3345). Estimate ~+15% monthly storage cost given two-year retention with immutability. Put note in renewal watch: "Requires contractual approval for retention cost before go-live."

Jordan (CSM): Thanks. I'll update the account health board: status=amber -> green if network and KMS fix by Thursday EOD.

OpsBot: Final automated scan before close: connectivity=partial, iam=ok, kms=partial, audit-forwarding=pending.

Jordan (CSM): We'll reconvene after Thursday validation call. If anyone uncovers more blockers, post here. Closing week0 triage for now.

Priya (CS Ops): :thumbsup:

Alex (NetEng): Will follow up with their infra.

Maya (Support): Calendar invite + dial-in posted.

Sam (Security): Monitoring INFRA-3345 and will escalate SLA breach if needed.
